items.title: T Mobile US (TMUS) Sets Up CFO Handover With Jessica Uhl Joining In September
items.summary: T-Mobile US (NasdaqGS:TMUS) has appointed Jessica Uhl as CFO Designate, with the role effective in mid-September. Uhl will work alongside current CFO Peter Osvaldik during an extended transition period as part of a multi-year succession plan. The incoming executive previously held senior finance roles at Shell and GE Vernova, bringing extensive global experience to T-Mobile’s leadership team.
